# my-homepage

Personal website & bilingual blog. SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 + Tailwind CSS 4 +
Velite, fully prerendered and deployed to a VPS via the SvelteKit Node adapter
(`deploy/deploy.sh`).

See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the full contributor guide (project
structure, commands, architecture notes, and conventions).

Quick start: `pnpm install`, then `pnpm dev`. Validate with `pnpm check` and
`pnpm build`.
